question.problem: Using the extended Euclidean algorithm, compute integers $u$ and $v$ such that $56u+24v=\text{gcd}(56,24).$ What is the value of $u+v?$
question.worked_solution:
We will use the extended Euclidean algorithm. First, we apply the forward reduction:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}56 & = & 24\cdot 2 & + & 8 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 24 & = & 8\cdot 3 & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

As a result, $\text{gcd}(56,24)=8.$

Solving for the remainders (the rightmost terms) in the equations above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}8 & =56-24\cdot 2 \\  & =56\cdot 1+24\cdot (-2)\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, $u=1$ and $v=-2.$

Finally, 

$$
u+v=1+(-2)=-1.
$$
